title: AWS North Virginia data center outage – recovery to take hours
summary: Major AWS data center outage in North Virginia disrupted services for FanDuel, Coinbase and other companies, with Amazon warning that recovery operations would take several hours to complete.
problem_solved: This is a breaking news incident report documenting an AWS cloud outage rather than a solution article.
why_valuable: Demonstrates the real-world impact of cloud infrastructure failures on critical services and highlights the importance of disaster recovery planning and multi-region architecture for mission-critical applications.
